policy: Preserve source inconsistencies and interpretation limits; do not silently repair

items.finding: Abstract and Table 1 attach 236 total elements to~109 ohm, whereas Device design explicitly gives 118-parallel per subarray and two in series.
items.guard: Keep physical chip, subarray and single-element identities distinct. Do not model the full series object as 109 ohm.

items.finding: Fig 2 a/b use 3 mA; Fig 2 c uses 5 mA. The caption links panels as a general analysis example but exact dataset correspondence is not supplied.
items.guard: No single inferred shared condition or synthetic merged dataset; require raw series provenance.

items.finding: The drawn figure has panelsa,b,c with Allan subplot inb; caption repeatsc and prose refers to 5 d.
items.guard: Use physical panel position plus content, not guessed repaired labels.

items.finding: SI p3 calls its summary Fig2 although the displayed summary is S3. Its expanded loop replaces a distinct edge with a repeated Array2–100 term, causing false cancellation. The resulting single-edge value is not evidence validating the intended three-edge loop. SI p4 refers to S3b rather than displayed S4b.
items.guard: Preserve printed-source discrepancy; independent metrologist defines signed graph and covariance before any new loop calculation. Do not execute the printed loop formula.

items.finding: Main Eq 3 uses second differences divided by averaging time squared, while prose calls x_i CCC-reading data. The precise integrated/phase versus direct ratio input semantics are not supplied.
items.guard: Hold executable analysis until x_i units, accumulation convention, timestamps and overlap definition are validated. Do not silently replace the source equation.

items.finding: 0.033±0.082 nΩ/Ω pooled result,~0.2 nΩ/Ω practical Allan limit, SI aggregate 0.03±0.04 nΩ/Ω and Table 1 rounded values are different summaries. Shared readings also imply correlations.
items.guard: No interchangeable accuracy claims; no uncorrelated pooling of overlapping network edges.

items.finding: Printed direct−0.0690±0.0006 and indirect−0.0730±0.0013 microΩ/Ω differ by 0.0040 microΩ/Ω. Assuming independent k=1 errors gives about 2.8 combined standard uncertainties; independence/covariance are not established.
items.guard: Record author agreement wording as interpretation; qualify statistical consistency separately. Arithmetic difference is an authored check, not source raw-data reanalysis.

items.finding: S1 appears flat above~3 T using regular voltmeter, while S2 precision tests detect loss below~4 T.
items.guard: Different measurement sensitivity; do not use 3 T as a universal quantization gate.

items.finding: Text considers either epigraphene departure, resistive NbN contacts, or both. The external 12.9 kiloohm check narrows common-mode departure but does not isolate its microscopic cause.
items.guard: Retain multiple hypotheses; do not invent a root-cause label.

items.finding: Winding ratio and approximate currents are given but current routing, bridge corrections, polarity cycle timing, integration configuration and signs are not complete.
items.guard: Use provider-qualified recipe with explicit target/reference identities; never convert listed integer ratio to a full measurement implementation.

items.finding: Repeated CCC blocks and two subarrays on one chip do not establish independent fabrication-batch or chip replicates.
items.guard: Do not report 236 specimens, two independent chips or>=45 fabrication repeats.

items.finding: SI says the 12.9 kiloohm standard can withstand higher currents, while its plotted 3,5,8.5 mA values describe subarray bias; the actual reference-resistor current and ratio are not explicitly specified there.
items.guard: Keep source wording bounded; no inference that 8.5 mA flows through 12.9 kiloohm standard. Require separate current/power limits for each device.

items.finding: Printed estimated relative error is 1/sqrt[2(N/n−1)], which increases with n for fixed N, although nearby prose says inverse-bin-size behavior. The percent subscript lacks an explicit×100 convention.
items.guard: Do not implement or use a full uncertainty budget from this expression without metrologist validation.

items.finding: Table 1 final row gives positive 0.5 nΩ/Ω; the plotted 4.25 T point is negative around−0.5 nΩ/Ω. It may be a magnitude but is not labeled as such.
items.evidence: MAIN p4 Table1 and p6 Fig5 lower panel
items.guard: Store both contexts and hold sign reconciliation; no exact digitization or silent sign fix.

items.finding: SI 4 identifies only one subarray, without naming Array1/Array2. Plot label is 2 K whereas general precision Methods says 2.1 K.
items.guard: Actual subarray, thermal history and temperature records are required; do not force 2.1 K onto this dataset.

items.finding: S2 title mentions array/Hall-bar but panels show subarrays and 100-ohm comparisons; its continuation references a supplementary main-text 2 a baseline instead of the matching main Fig 4 context.
items.guard: Use depicted measurement identities and preserve caption/reference mismatch as source annotation.

items.finding: MAIN definesQ=RB/RA and deviation of testB relative to referenceA; labels usingA−B need not mean an ordinary subtraction of two absolute resistances.
items.guard: Store reference/test roles, measured ratio and sign explicitly; define inverse edges before closure.

items.finding: SI 3 calls loop bounds expanded without an explicit coverage factor in that sentence.
items.guard: Do not silently assignk=2 or mix with its figure k=1-style SEM errors.
